It appears to be derived from the environmentandhealth table columns (waterqualityindex, sanitationcoverage, vaccinationcoverage, diseaserisk, medicalemergencycapacity, mentalhealthaid). result: The "Health Resilience Score" is calculated by taking 40% of the water quality index, 30% of the sanitation coverage, and 30% of the vaccination coverage. A "Health Crisis" is identified if the disease risk is 'High', the water quality index is below 50, and the calculated Health Resilience Score is less than 40.

SELECT 
    e.envhealthregistry,
    e.envdistref,
    ROUND((0.40 * e.waterqualityindex + 0.30 * e.sanitationcoverage + 0.30 * e.vaccinationcoverage), 2) AS health_resilience_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN e.diseaserisk = 'High' 
             AND e.waterqualityindex < 50 
             AND (0.40 * e.waterqualityindex + 0.30 * e.sanitationcoverage + 0.30 * e.vaccinationcoverage) < 40 
        THEN 'Health Crisis'
        ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
    END AS status_label
FROM environmentandhealth e
ORDER BY envhealthregistry;
